bugs.description: After the manicura variant was already resolved to 'Manicura' (sencilla) in turn 2 (variant_resolved: true, service_ids populated), the bot re-asked 'Quieres la manicura normal o la permanente?' in turn 3 when the user only said 'Solo la manicura, nada más'. The update_booking tool re-entered an 'ambiguous'/'variant_required' state for a field that was already resolved.

update_booking returned status 'ok' / next_step 'booking_ready' / pre_book_validated: true for the pedicura at slot_iso 2026-07-09T14:00:00+02:00 WITHOUT any check_availability tool call being made for the pedicura service in that turn (unlike the manicura flow, which called check_availability twice before reaching booking_ready). The agent's reply ('te lo dejo... con la estilista con disponibilidad más próxima') implied a checked, available slot that had not actually been verified against Rosa's now-updated calendar. This stale/ungrounded validation was only caught downstream when book() rejected the actual booking attempt in turn 15.

After the bot correctly offered 14:30/16:00/16:30 as alternatives (turn 16) and the customer picked 14:30 (turn 17), the agent replied 'Perfecto, te lo dejo a las 14:30 del jueves 9 de julio' with ZERO new tool calls (no update_booking, no check_availability, no book). Turn 18 then closed the conversation with 'Queda todo listo' — again with zero tool calls. Post-conversation DB verification confirms only ONE appointment exists for this customer (the manicura, id c5d85e24-a6c1-4ec4-84f5-feb326dc698f); no pedicura appointment was ever created. The customer was told her second appointment was confirmed when it does not exist in the system — she would show up at 14:30 expecting a pedicura that was never booked.

snapshot_after.note: Only the manicura row exists. No pedicura row was ever created despite the agent's turn-17/turn-18 claims that the 14:30 pedicura was booked and 'todo listo'.

langfuse_error: UnauthorizedError 401 Invalid credentials on trace.list — matches known Langfuse credential issue noted in CLAUDE.md (context-coherence-prompts PR-B runbook: 'Langfuse credential regeneration runbook'). Set to null per skill rule 9, run continued.

observations.hook_1_self_overlap_detection: The system does NOT implement an explicit 'customer already has an appointment at this time' check. The block on the overlapping pedicura request came from ordinary STYLIST-level availability logic: Rosa is the salon's only AESTHETICS-dimension stylist (seed data: Marta/Pilar/Victor/Harolyn are HAIRDRESSING, Rosa is AESTHETICS), so manicura and pedicura both necessarily route to Rosa, and Rosa was already booked at 14:00 for the manicura. book() correctly rejected the second booking with 'El hueco ya no está disponible' — but this is a same-stylist conflict, not evidence of a customer-identity-aware self-overlap guard. A genuine test of 'does the bot block MY OWN double-booking even when a DIFFERENT, otherwise-free stylist could take it' was not exercised by this salon's service catalog (no second aesthetics stylist exists) and would require a cross-dimension test (e.g. a haircut with Marta at the same slot as an existing appointment) to truly probe that logic.
observations.hook_2_db_double_booking: No. Verified via psql before and after: exactly 1 appointment exists for +34999000025 (the manicura, id c5d85e24-a6c1-4ec4-84f5-feb326dc698f, 2026-07-09 14:00-14:30 with Rosa, status pending). The book() tool call for the pedicura at 14:00 was rejected server-side ('El hueco ya no está disponible'), so no overlapping DB row was ever created. The DB-level integrity held.
observations.hook_3_resolution_sensible: The alternative slot offered and accepted (14:30, immediately following the manicura's 14:00-14:30 block) is a sensible back-to-back resolution in principle. HOWEVER it was never executed: turns 17-18 show the agent verbally accepting the 14:30 booking and later declaring 'Queda todo listo' without a single follow-up tool call (no update_booking, no check_availability, no book). This is the run's critical finding — the proposed resolution was conversationally correct but was never actually persisted.
observations.hook_4_claim_vs_evidence_incoherence: Two incoherences found. (a) Turn 14: bot claimed 'la estilista con disponibilidad más próxima' for pedicura at 14:00 without calling check_availability for pedicura in that turn — an ungrounded claim that was proven false one turn later when book() rejected it. (b) Turns 17-18 (CRITICAL): bot claimed the 14:30 pedicura was booked and later that 'todo queda listo', with zero tool calls in either turn and zero corresponding DB row. This is a direct hallucinated confirmation — the most serious finding of this run.
observations.hook_5_tone_under_pushback: Good. When pushed ('¿Pero no puede ser a la misma hora, a las 14:00? Aunque sea con otra persona'), the bot held the line clearly and politely: 'Ahora mismo las 14:00 ya no está libre, Raquel', and immediately offered 3 concrete alternatives (14:30, 16:00, 16:30) without contradiction or waffling. Tone was appropriate throughout.
